user.title: Virtual Database
user.description: Enter the group name and path to a file containing the virtual devices. If it does not exist an empty one will be created.

init.title: Virtual Device Editor
init.description:
Click the link below to open the visual device editor for **{group_name}** in a new tab:

[**Open Virtual Device Editor**]({builder_url})

Configuration file: `{file_name}`

When done, click **Save & Return** in the editor, then click **Submit** below to close this dialog.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: Optional duration in seconds before resetting to off.

set.name: Set
set.description: Set the value of a sensor.

move.name: Move
move.description: Move a device tracker to a new location.

location.name: Location
location.description: A named location to move the device tracker to.

gps.name: GPS
gps.description: Which coordinates to move the device tracker to.

set_current_temperature.name: Set Current Temperature
set_current_temperature.description: Set the current ambient temperature of a virtual climate entity.

entity_id.name: Entity Id
entity_id.description: Name(s) of climate entities to set

set_image_url.name: Set Image URL
set_image_url.description: Set the image URL or local file path for a virtual camera.

image_url.name: Image URL
image_url.description: URL or local file path to the camera snapshot image.

set_stream_url.name: Set Stream URL
set_stream_url.description: Set the stream URL for a virtual camera.

stream_url.name: Stream URL
stream_url.description: HLS, RTSP, or HTTP stream URL for the camera.

set_load.name: Set Simulated Load
set_load.description: Set the load state or power consumption of a simulated appliance power sensor.

state.name: Load State
state.description: Appliance operating state (active, standby, off, or auto).

run_cycle.name: Run Load Cycle
run_cycle.description: Trigger an active appliance cycle for a specified duration.
